list.title: Email messages
list.description: The delivery log: every message this CMS has handed to the mail provider, newest first. Nothing here is editable — sending is what writes a row.
list.panel_description: A queued message changes state on the server. Refresh to see where it got to.
list.caption: Messages sent from the CMS
list.empty_description: Every message the CMS sends is logged here, along with whatever the provider had to say about it. Write the first one.

recipients.placeholder: Type an address and press Enter
recipients.hint: Enter or a comma adds it to the list.
recipients.full: That is as many recipients as one message takes.
recipients.duplicate: {{- address}} is already on the list.

compose.title: Compose a message
compose.description: Send a stored template with its variables filled in, or write a one-off message by hand. It goes out as soon as you confirm.
compose.recipients_description: Up to 20 addresses on the “to” line of one message.
compose.from_hint: Leave it empty to send from the CMS's own address. The service refuses a sender it is not allowed to use.
compose.reply_to_hint: Where a reply should land, when that is not the sender.
compose.mode_template_description: Pick a stored template; the service renders it with the variables you fill in below.
compose.mode_custom_description: Write the subject and the body here. Nothing is stored — this message exists only in the log.
compose.template_hint: Templates are managed under Email → Templates.
compose.template_unknown: “{{- slug}}” is not one of the stored templates. If it was deleted, the service will answer that there is no such template.
compose.no_templates_body: There is nothing to pick from until a template exists.
compose.template_subject_hint: The template's own subject. A subject sent alongside a template overrides it, so this screen never sends one — to change it, edit the template.
compose.variables_hint: Taken from reading the template's own text and looking for its placeholders — a convenience, not a list the API publishes. Anything the scan missed, add by hand.
compose.variables_empty: This template mentions no variables. If you know it expects one, add it by hand.
compose.add_variable_hint: The name inside the placeholder, without the braces.
compose.subject_hint: Up to 200 characters — it is the first thing an inbox shows.
compose.layout_branded_hint: Wraps your HTML in the site's house layout — header, footer, and the heading below.
compose.layout_raw_hint: Sends your HTML exactly as written, with nothing around it. A heading has nowhere to go, so it is not sent.
compose.heading_hint: The title the house layout prints above the body.
compose.html_hint: The preview runs inside a sandboxed frame, so nothing in it executes.
compose.text_hint: Optional: the alternative for clients that do not render HTML. Left empty, the service derives one from the HTML body itself.
compose.confirm_template: The template “{{- template}}” goes out to {{recipients}}. Mail cannot be called back once it leaves.
compose.confirm_custom: “{{- subject}}” goes out to {{recipients}}. Mail cannot be called back once it leaves.
compose.sent: Sent. The record is in the log.
compose.rejected: Recorded, but the provider refused it. The record says what it can.
compose.rejected_reason: Recorded, but the provider refused it: {{- error}}
compose.recorded: The attempt was recorded. The log has where it stands.

errors.no_template: Choose a template, or switch to a one-off message.
errors.no_body: A message needs a body — HTML, plain text, or both.

detail.delivery_description: What the service recorded about this attempt.
detail.failed_unknown: The service recorded a failure without saying more.
detail.recipients_unknown: The service does not report the recipients of this message.
detail.inline_body: None — this message carried its own body.
detail.heading: Heading
detail.body_description: The message exactly as it went out — the service keeps the body it delivered.
detail.body_absent: The service does not return the body for this message.
detail.html_preview_title: The HTML body as it was sent
